@kbench.task(name="ladder-probe")
def ladder(llm) -> tuple[int, int]:
    agg = collections.defaultdict(lambda: [0, 0])
    for p in P:
        with kbench.chats.new(f"{p['k']}-{len(agg)}-{agg[p['k']][1]}"):
            out = llm.prompt(PROMPT.format(q=p["q"], a=p["a"], b=p["b"]))
        t = (out or "").strip().upper().strip(" .*`\n")
        ok = t.startswith(p["correct"])
        agg[p["k"]][1] += 1
        agg[p["k"]][0] += int(ok)
    print("\n===== LADDER RESULT =====")
    tot_g = tot_n = 0
    for k in sorted(agg):
        g, n = agg[k]
        tot_g += g; tot_n += n
        print(f"gap={k} claim(s) removed -> pretty-but-worse REJECTED {g}/{n} = {g/n:.0%}")
    return tot_g, tot_n
